person_made_it: Eric's whole year on his own board structure: Groups Home, Family, Community, Work, Play, Friendship; items with Owner, Timeline, Status, a latest update, MoSCoW priority and a Definition of Done. Every item is something Gordon named: the historic house, being Dad, Cider Camp, healthy growth at work, the Dragon House, Gordtopia, the calls.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Darby, openly, with love from Gordon.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: golden hour on the board, twilight in the scenes, premiere night at the end
did_the_click_pay_me: each status opens a scene with its own play (paint the house, pour cider, grow the plant, roll a natural 20, build blocks, answer Gordon's call); all seven green triggers a clapperboard, a montage, a marquee that lights his name, fireworks, a 40 second credits roll to a live score and a standing ovation
works_for_the_recipient: Phone-first, tested in Safari and Chrome engines.
taught_me_something: the latest-update bubbles speak his own tool's language back to him
told_me_the_truth: only what Gordon named; Magic Castle removed because Eric was not there; no names of his children on a public page
weakest: scene interactions are simple taps rather than richer gestures
